messages:
lucy (partnerships): Heads-up: we're planning a small, additive API tweak that will affect connector certs and marketplace adapters. need quick alignment on certification matrix + partner test harness. @alex can you pull in vendor owners?

omar (eng-platform): +1. what's changing exactly? can we keep it opt-in for older SDKs?

lucy (partnerships): It's an optional response field: `response.metadata.source.platform` — will be populated by marketplace/hw adaptors to indicate inferred platform (e.g., gcp-marketplace, partner-epoch). Not required for correctness, but used by routing analytics and some quality rules.

mina (eng-ml): This is additive so runtime behavior shouldn't break, but SDKs that strict-validate responses will need a patch. we'll provide a compatibility shim in 2.3.x.

alex (partner-eng): I'll start a vendor ping. timeline? partners will want a minimum notice window and a certification test they can run locally.

lucy (partnerships): Proposed timeline: announce on Mon 2w notice, soft-enforce in 8w (warning only), hard-enforce in 20w (marketplace listings must accept or opt-out). Thoughts?

sara (legal): Make sure notices map to terms around API changes in partner agreements. i'll draft a short addendum and pre-approve the customer-facing text.

omar (eng-platform): For gating: we should require that any marketplace adapter exposes a `compat-check` endpoint and we run a canned suite. I'll add a CI job. sample smoke:

```
POST /compat-check
{ "sample_response": true }
expect: 200, includes optional metadata field when enabled
```

ci-bot: CI job created: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/compat-check-34680 (runs nightly; artifacts -> /artifacts/compat/34680) :eyes:

alex (partner-eng): Good. i'll share the test harness (docker + node script) with partners tonight. planning to include a simple golden response file + invalidation cases.

mina (eng-ml): Also adding a small eval to ensure `source.platform` doesn't leak PII; we have a quick regex scrub in the harness.

lucy (partnerships): Checklist for launch (short):
- [ ] Draft partner notice + FAQ (sara)
- [ ] Publish test harness repo + docker image (alex)
- [ ] CI compat-check job & publishing of artifacts (omar / ci-bot)
- [ ] SDK minor bump + shim release (mina)
- [ ] Marketplace listing requirement update (product/legal)

lucy (partnerships): Assigning: alex -> partner comms + vendor ping; omar -> CI gating + release notes; mina -> SDK shim + quick patch; sara -> legal text. i'll consolidate into a PR for announcement tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex (partner-eng): On it. i'll create the vendor spreadsheet and ask who needs assisted help.

omar (eng-platform): i'll schedule the nightly compat-run for the next 3 weeks and add a dashboard tile for failures.

ci-bot: nightly runs scheduled starting 3468010200. failures will create tickets in #support-partner-ci.

lucy (partnerships): thanks everyone. i'll post the draft notice once sara and alex finish their sections. if anyone sees blockers ping me directly. :pray:
